_comment: Your weekly schedule template + one-off blocks. Copy to db/schedule_template.json and edit, then load with `python -m db.load_schedule`. Recurring blocks use `days` (mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun | weekdays | daily). One-off blocks use `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) instead. Times are HH:MM in the hub timezone. `goal` is what you must achieve in the block.

blocks.label: eBay shipping
blocks.goal: Pack and ship the day's sold lots
